description: Database Slow Query - Creates ephemeral load generator to run deliberately long-running queries, so long-running-query monitoring and alarms can be validated

ExecuteSlowQueries.description: Run concurrent long-running queries for a configurable duration and report whether they were visible to server-side monitoring
